structured_output.analysis:
There is almost no room in the budget. The best grid, iso_3.15, measures 0.4361 KL [E514ab09c524e] at 3.14795 average bits, against a cap of 3.1484 (403/128). That leaves about 0.0005 bits per weight, so no layer can be moved up a bit-width unless another is moved down.

The loss is concentrated in MLP layers. Most of them already use the lowest-KL method at their bit-width. For example, 27.up_proj measures 0.00572 with gptq_int3 [Ef04d8aa7bded] versus 0.00774 with rht_gptq_int3 [E8972491007e7], and 3.up_proj is already on rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5]. So changing methods at the same width gains nothing.

Upgrading 14.down_proj from rht_gptq_int2 (0.00633, [E4c3f9b73e065]) to rht_gptq_int3 (0.00181, [E90bd4b2f3645]) would need about 1 extra bit per weight on 3.1M weights. The only way to pay for that is to move some 3-bit layer down to 2 bits, and none of the retrieved records shows a 3-bit layer that is cheap to downgrade.

That leaves GPTQ options that don't change stored bits: act_order and damp (group_size would change bits). The measured KL (0.436) is above the single-layer-sum prediction (0.398), which suggests errors interact across layers. Better per-layer error compensation might help with that. Every proposal below is a pure option change with no cell changes, so all stay within budget.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: Sets act_order=true for all GPTQ variants and keeps the cells unchanged, so stored bits stay the same. The base measures 0.43614 KL [E514ab09c524e]. The layers losing the most KL are gptq/rht_gptq layers, such as 27.up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded] and 14.down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065].

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp02
proposals.rationale: Sets act_order=true and damp=0.02, with no change in bits. The aim is to regularize the Hessian for the 2-bit layers, where KL is high: 18.gate_proj rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00497 [Eb1dd74cd6447] and 14.down_proj at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065]. Base: 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp005
proposals.rationale: Lowers damp to 0.005 with no change in bits, giving a sweep in the opposite direction to damp=0.02. Base: 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e]. 3.up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 is among the layers losing the most, at 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5].
